briefdescription.para: Performs 3-level multistage table lookup for character properties.

detaileddescription.para: This function implements an O(1) lookup from a Unicode codepoint to its packed CharProps. A 3-level table structure is used instead of a direct 1.1M-entry array to conserve memory while maintaining constant-time access.

Multistage Table Structure
Level 1 (T1): 4352 entries - coarse index from top 8 bits (cp >> 8)
Level 2 (T2): 46592 entries - medium index combining T1 result + lower bits
Level 3 (T3): Final CharProps value
The lookup formula: T3[T2[(T1[cp>>8]<<8)|(cp&0xFF)]]

simplesect.title: Branchless Clamp
simplesect.para: Invalid codepoints (greater than MAX_UNICODE = 0x10FFFF) are clamped to 0 using a branchless technique: mask=(cp-(MAX_UNICODE+1))>>63//0xFFFFFFFFifinvalid,0ifvalid cp=cp&mask//0ifinvalid,unchangedifvalid This avoids branch misprediction penalties on hot paths.

parameterdescription.para: Unicode codepoint (0 to 0x10FFFF, or invalid values clamped)

simplesect.para: CharProps for the given codepoint, or default properties for invalid codepoints

listitem.para: Time complexity: O(1), typically 3 array accesses
Branchless: No conditional branches in the hot path
Cache-friendly: T1 fits in L1 cache, T2/T3 accessed sequentially

briefdescription.para: Performs one state machine transition for grapheme segmentation.

detaileddescription.para: This function implements one step of the Unicode grapheme cluster boundary determination algorithm per UAX #29. Given the previous state and the current character's properties, it returns the new state and whether a cluster boundary occurs.

simplesect.title: State Machine
simplesect.para:
The state machine uses a multistage lookup similar to charPropsFor():
Key = (prev_state << 7) | graphemeSegmentationProperty
Lookup in 3-level tables to get new state + boundary flag
GraphemeSegmentationResult with new state and addToCurrentCell flag
GraphemeBreakProperty for the possible character classes

briefdescription.para: Returns the initial state for grapheme segmentation.

detaileddescription.para: Creates the starting state for processing a new text run. The initial state corresponds to "Positioning at Start" in UAX #29, where the previous character is treated as if it were GBP=Any (matches everything) to ensure the first character always starts a new cluster.

simplesect.title: Initial State Value
simplesect.para:
The value 0 encodes:
state() = 0 (AtStart state index)
addToCurrentCell() = false (first char always starts new cell)

briefdescription.para: Packed Unicode character property lookup system for terminal emulation.

detaileddescription.para: This file provides O(1) character property lookups for terminal rendering, including character width calculation, emoji detection, and grapheme cluster segmentation per Unicode Standard Annex #29.
The data is stored in bit-packed structures to maximize cache efficiency and minimize memory bandwidth during text rendering operations.

simplesect.para: CharPropsData.h for the lookup table definitions
